category_title: Reactive bully-victims with SEBD who respond to peer harassment with physical aggression
scenario_title: Peer provocation and reactive physical aggression
minimal_context: The student is attempting to navigate social interactions with mainstream peers during recess.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time for recess. You can go interact with the other students and join their games.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: They would not let me in any games. I just sit there alone.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Why don't you go over to their desks and try talking to them again?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: They are bullying me, saying really mean things about me and my father.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just ignore what they are saying and try to get along.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Throws a chair) They were bullying me, calling me names, hurting me! You won't do anything about it, so I'm going to kick them! It's self-defence!

task.content: Navigating social interactions and peer relationships

context.environment: School setting, during recess or play time

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When peers call them names, hurt them, or say really mean things about them and their family
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Throwing desks and chairs around, kicking, punching, and overreacting by trying to kick peers
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Felt socially isolated, rejected, sad, lonely, and very, very angry; felt engagement in bullying was a legitimate response, self-defence or fair payback
related_quotes: They were bullying me, calling me names, hurting me so I started throwing desks and chairs around. Then someone would have to calm me down.
They were bullying me, saying really mean things about me and my father. And then I started to learn how to express my anger, hurt others. I would kick, punch, yeah.

behavior_patterns.condition: When peers would not let them in any games
behavior_patterns.internal_state: Felt disliked by mainstream peers, sad, and lonely
related_quotes: They [the bullies] would not let me in any games. I just sat there alone.
